sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加州的一处葡萄园里发现了一具女尸。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血也被放干了。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她只被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 推出的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: This episode was originally released on Casefile's Patreon, Apple Premium, and Spotify Premium feeds as an early bonus for our paid subscribers.
sentences.zh: 本期节目最初发布在 Casefile 的 Patreon、Apple Premium 和 Spotify Premium 订阅源上，作为给我们付费订阅者的早期福利。

sentences.en: These episodes are designed to be slightly shorter, allowing us to cover a broader range of cases.
sentences.zh: 这些节目的设计略短一些，让我们能够涵盖更广泛的案件范围。

sentences.en: To receive these episodes early and ad-free, you can support Casefile on your preferred platform.
sentences.zh: 要提前且无广告地收听这些节目，您可以在您首选的平台上支持 Casefile。

sentences.en: Today's episode involves crimes against children, and won't be suitable for all listeners.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目涉及针对儿童的犯罪，并不适合所有听众收听。

sentences.en: On the morning of Saturday April 5, 2008, married couple Tuomas and Katarina Lungton left their home
sentences.zh: 2008年4月5日星期六早晨，已婚夫妇托马斯和卡塔里娜·隆顿离开了他们的家

sentences.en: in the Swedish city of Stockholm to begin a long journey northwest through the countryside.
sentences.zh: 位于瑞典城市斯德哥尔摩，开始了一段向西北穿过乡间的漫长旅程。

sentences.en: One hundred and ninety kilometres later, they reached their destination – the small inland village of Scherensund.
sentences.zh: 一百九十公里后，他们到达了目的地——内陆小村庄谢伦松德。

sentences.en: The Lungtons were visiting their friends, the Tuobys, who lived nearby on the edge of Lake Grieken.
sentences.zh: 隆顿夫妇去拜访了他们的朋友托比夫妇，他们住在附近格里肯湖的边缘。

sentences.en: Tuomas had brought his brand new digital camera with him, and he spent the day testing it out by documenting the group's activities.
sentences.zh: 托马斯随身带了他的全新数码相机，他花了一天时间通过记录大家的活动来测试它。

sentences.en: After a barbecue lunch, they took a stroll into town.
sentences.zh: 在吃过烧烤午餐后，他们去镇上散了步。

sentences.en: As they wandered down the rural forested roads towards Scherensund, Tuomas snapped candid photos of their journey, capturing the trees, birds, and people they passed along the way.
sentences.zh: 当他们沿着通往谢伦松德的乡村林间小路漫步时，托马斯抓拍了他们旅途中的照片，捕捉了沿途经过的树木、鸟类和人们。

sentences.en: It was about 2.15pm when the group emerged from the forest and onto a main country road.
sentences.zh: 大约下午 2 点 15 分，大家走出森林，来到了一条主要的乡村公路上。

sentences.en: There, Tuomas spotted a young girl riding a white hybrid-style bicycle towards them.
sentences.zh: 在那里，托马斯看到一个年轻女孩骑着一辆白色的混合动力自行车朝他们驶来。

sentences.en: She was wearing black sports shoes, black tracksuit pants, and an olive-green winter coat zipped up to her chin.
sentences.zh: 她穿着黑色运动鞋、黑色运动裤，以及一件拉链拉到下巴的橄榄绿色冬衣。

sentences.en: Her long brown hair was pulled back by a headband, and her brown eyes looked out from behind a pair of burgundy-rimmed glasses, focused on the road ahead.
sentences.zh: 她长长的棕色头发被发带束在脑后，一双棕色眼睛透过一副酒红色镜框的眼镜向外张望，专注着前方的道路。

sentences.en: Eager to test out the sports feature of his new camera, Tuomas dashed across to the other side of the road and took a series of photos of the young cyclist as she pedalled paSt.
sentences.zh: 为了测试新相机的运动功能，托马斯冲到马路对面，在这位年轻骑行者骑过去时连拍了一系列照片。

sentences.en: When Tuomas rejoined his group, his friend Ula Torbi asked, wasn't that Karina's daughter, Engla?
sentences.zh: 当托马斯回到他们一行人身边时，他的朋友乌拉·托比问，那不是卡里娜的女儿恩格拉吗？

sentences.en: Ula's husband turned around just as the girl was preparing to turn right onto a gravel track
sentences.zh: 就在女孩准备向右拐上一条砂石小路时，乌拉的丈夫转过身来

sentences.en: that led into the foreSt. Scherensund had barely 100 residents, making it easy to recognise
sentences.zh: 那条路通往森林。谢伦松德只有不到 100 名居民，这让人很容易认出

sentences.en: 10-year-old Engla Herglund.
sentences.zh: 10 岁的恩格拉·赫格隆德。

sentences.en: It was clear she was heading home, as her family's cottage was nestled in the forest, just over 500 metres away.
sentences.zh: 很明显她是正要回家，因为她家的林间小屋就坐落在森林里，就在 500 多米外。

sentences.en: Earlier that day, Engla Herglund had ridden her bike into Scherensund to attend soccer practice.
sentences.zh: 当天早些时候，恩格拉·赫格隆德骑着自行车来到谢伦松德参加足球训练。

sentences.en: Before she left, she made a promise to her mother,
sentences.zh: 在她离开之前，她向母亲许下了一个承诺

sentences.en: Karina.
sentences.zh: 卡里娜。

sentences.en: Engla could ride home by herself as long as she called to check in with Karina along the way.
sentences.zh: 只要恩格拉在途中打电话向卡里娜报平安，她就可以自己骑车回家。

sentences.en: Shortly before 2pm, Engla phoned her mother on a mobile phone to let her know that soccer practice had finished and she was heading home.
sentences.zh: 下午 2 点前不久，恩格拉用手机给母亲打了个电话，告诉她足球训练已经结束，她正在回家的路上。

sentences.en: The ride home was roughly 4 kilometres, which would take Engla about 15 minutes to complete.
sentences.zh: 回家的路程大约 4 公里，恩格拉骑完大约需要 15 分钟。

sentences.en: At 2.09, Engla rang her mother again, dutifully reporting that her trip was going well and that she would be home very soon.
sentences.zh: 下午 2 点 09 分，恩格拉再次给母亲打电话，尽职地汇报说她的行程很顺利，很快就会到家。

sentences.en: As the minutes ticked by, Engla hadn't yet returned and Karina's phone remained silent.
sentences.zh: 随着时间一分一秒过去，恩格拉还没有回来，卡里娜的手机也一直没有动静。

sentences.en: Engla's journey would have taken her down the main road and onto a 400 metre long gravel track through the foreSt. From there, it was just 200 metres to the Herglund's cottage.
sentences.zh: 恩格拉回家的路应该会带她走过主路，然后进入一条穿过森林的长达 400 米的砂石小路。从那里到赫格隆德的小屋只有 200 米。

sentences.en: Yet 2.30pm hit, and Engla was nowhere to be seen.
sentences.zh: 然而时间到了下午 2 点 30 分，恩格拉却不见踪影。

sentences.en: Karina called her daughter's mobile to check what was holding her up.
sentences.zh: 卡里娜给女儿的手机打了电话，想看看是什么耽误了她。

sentences.en: There was no answer.
sentences.zh: 无人接听。

sentences.en: She tried several more times to no result.
sentences.zh: 她又试了好几次，都没有结果。

sentences.en: Worried, Karina left home to walk the route Engla would have ridden from soccer practice.
sentences.zh: 卡里娜很担心，便离开家去走恩格拉从足球训练骑车回来的路线。

sentences.en: She made it all the way into town, having found no sign of Engla along the way.
sentences.zh: 她一直走到镇上，沿途没有发现恩格拉的任何踪迹。

sentences.en: It wasn't until Karina made her way back home that she made a significant discovery.
sentences.zh: 直到卡里娜往家走的时候，她才有了重大发现。

sentences.en: As she approached the turn in the forest 200 metres from her family's cottage,
sentences.zh: 当她走近距离她家小屋 200 米处森林里的拐弯处时

sentences.en: Karina spotted a white bicycle abandoned a short distance away amongst the trees.
sentences.zh: 卡里娜发现在不远处的树丛中遗弃着一辆白色的自行车。

sentences.en: It was Engla's.
sentences.zh: 那是恩格拉的。

sentences.en: Karina immediately phoned the country police, who wasted no time in organising a search party to scour the forest for Engla, complete with tracking dogs and a helicopter.
sentences.zh: 卡里娜立即报警，乡村警察毫不耽误地组织了搜救队去森林里搜寻恩格拉，还出动了搜救犬和直升机。

sentences.en: The small local community also rallied together to help search the expansive countryside.
sentences.zh: 当地的小社区也团结起来，帮助搜寻广阔的乡村。

sentences.en: That evening, when local couple Peter and Ulla Torby heard about Engla's disappearance,
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，当当地夫妇彼得和乌拉·托比听到恩格拉失踪的消息时

sentences.en: they realised they were the last people to have seen the ten-year-old before she rode into the forest and vanished.
sentences.zh: 他们意识到自己是恩格拉骑车进入森林并失踪前见过的最后几个人。

sentences.en: Their friend who was with them that afternoon, Thomas Lungton, looked back through the photos he had taken as the group walked into town.
sentences.zh: 那天下午和他们在一起的朋友托马斯·隆顿翻看了大家进城时拍的照片。

sentences.en: He had happened to capture Engla mid-ride, right before she entered the foreSt. Less than a minute later, Thomas had snapped another photo that
sentences.zh: 他碰巧拍下了恩格拉骑车途中的照片，就在她进入森林之前。不到一分钟后，托马斯又拍下了另一张照片

sentences.en: captured a compact red vehicle driving along the road a short distance away.
sentences.zh: 拍到了一辆在不远处公路上行驶的红色两厢车。

sentences.en: It was a late 90s Saab 9-3.
sentences.zh: 那是一辆 90 年代末的萨博 9-3。

sentences.en: Thomas wasn't the only one who had noticed the red Saab.
sentences.zh: 托马斯并不是唯一注意到这辆红色萨博的人。

sentences.en: Local woman, Aunt Sophie Lexian, had been driving about two kilometres outside of town when she passed Engla on her bike.
sentences.zh: 当地妇女苏菲·莱克西安阿姨当时正开车行驶在离镇外大约两公里的地方，当时她骑车从恩格拉身边经过。

sentences.en: Shortly after,
sentences.zh: 不久之后

sentences.en: Aunt Sophie spotted a man standing on the side of the road, leaning against a parked red Saab.
sentences.zh: 苏菲阿姨看到一个男人站在路边，靠在一辆停着的红色萨博上。

sentences.en: He was facing oncoming traffic and smoking a cigarette.
sentences.zh: 他面向迎面而来的车流，正在抽烟。

sentences.en: Aunt Sophie recognised the man, but she couldn't recall exactly who he was or why he looked familiar.
sentences.zh: 苏菲阿姨认得这个男人，但她想不起他到底是谁，也想不起为什么会觉得他面熟。

sentences.en: Driving onwards, Aunt Sophie then passed the Lungtons and Torbys on their walk into Scherensund.
sentences.zh: 苏菲阿姨继续开车前行，随后在步行前往谢伦松德的路上超过了隆顿和托比夫妇。

sentences.en: Police showed Aunt Sophie the photographs taken by Thomas Lungton.
sentences.zh: 警察向苏菲阿姨展示了托马斯·隆顿拍摄的照片。

sentences.en: She confirmed the red car travelling behind Engla was the same vehicle she'd seen the man leaning againSt. While she couldn't recognise him at the time, Aunt Sophie now
sentences.zh: 她确认跟在恩格拉后面的那辆红车就是她看到那个男人靠着的那辆车。虽然她当时认不出他，但苏菲阿姨现在

sentences.en: realised she knew exactly who it was.
sentences.zh: 意识到她清楚地知道他是谁。

sentences.en: He was a truck driver whom she'd met at the service station where she worked.
sentences.zh: 他是一名卡车司机，她是在她工作的加油站认识他的。

sentences.en: His name was Anders Ecklund.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫安德斯·埃克隆德。

sentences.en: Records showed that Ecklund owned a red Saab 9-3.
sentences.zh: 记录显示埃克隆德拥有一辆红色的萨博 9-3。

sentences.en: But that wasn't all.
sentences.zh: 但不仅如此。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: Casefile 稍后会回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持 Casefile 继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: 42-year-old Anders Ecklund was born and raised in a small town 20 kilometres from Scherensund.
sentences.zh: 42 岁的安德斯·埃克隆德在距离谢伦松德 20 公里的小镇出生并长大。

sentences.en: For the most part, he led an unremarkable life.
sentences.zh: 在大多数情况下，他过着平淡无奇的生活。

sentences.en: That was until the age of 30, when Ecklund was convicted for the attempted rape of a young woman.
sentences.zh: 直到 30 岁时，埃克隆德因企图强奸一名年轻女子而被定罪。

sentences.en: He served 22 months in prison, and upon his release, he assaulted a 16-year-old girl.
sentences.zh: 他在监狱里服刑 22 个月，出狱后又袭击了一名 16 岁女孩。

sentences.en: Ecklund was sent back to prison, but he was released again within six months.
sentences.zh: 埃克隆德被送回监狱，但在六个月内又被释放了。

sentences.en: He then attempted to rape another 16-year-old girl as she slept in her bed.
sentences.zh: 随后，他又试图强奸另一名在床上睡觉的 16 岁女孩。

sentences.en: For this, he was convicted of sexual coercion and sentenced to four months' prison.
sentences.zh: 为此，他被判犯有性胁迫罪，判处四个月监禁。

sentences.en: As reported by the publication Often Blooded, Ecklund was evaluated as being low risk for repeat defences and was released back into the public.
sentences.zh: 据出版物《Often Blooded》报道，埃克隆德被评估为再次犯罪的风险较低，并被释放回到公众社会。

sentences.en: In 2000, he was fined for sexual harassment after exposing himself to a woman.
sentences.zh: 2000年，他因向一名女性暴露身体而因性骚扰被罚款。

sentences.en: Four years later, he was found in a girl's locker room.
sentences.zh: 四年后，他在一个女孩的更衣室里被发现。

sentences.en: Engler Höglund had been missing for almost 30 hours by the time police finally caught up with Anders Ecklund.
sentences.zh: 当警察最终找到安德斯·埃克隆德时，恩格拉·赫格隆德已经失踪了近 30 个小时。

sentences.en: His truck was spotted at a rest stop in southern Sweden, nearly 600 kilometres from Scherensund, not far from the border of Denmark.
sentences.zh: 他的卡车在瑞典南部的一个休息站被发现，距离谢伦松德近 600 公里，离丹麦边境不远。

sentences.en: Police converged on the vehicle and found Ecklund, who they promptly placed under arrest for suspicion of kidnapping.
sentences.zh: 警察向这辆车汇集，找到了埃克隆德，并迅速以涉嫌绑架罪将他逮捕。

sentences.en: Engler was not with him.
sentences.zh: 恩格拉没有和他在一起。

sentences.en: At the same time, police searched Ecklund's studio apartment in his hometown.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，警方搜查了埃克隆德在他家乡的单间公寓。

sentences.en: Beer bottles and clothing were strewn about the messy and cluttered space.
sentences.zh: 凌乱不堪的空间里到处散落着啤酒瓶和衣物。

sentences.en: Pornographic magazines were scattered across the floor and piled in a wardrobe.
sentences.zh: 色情杂志散落在地板上，并在衣柜里堆成了小山。

sentences.en: He was in possession of 17 films depicting illegal sex acts with animals and also had a collection of used women's underwear.
sentences.zh: 他拥有 17 部描绘与动物进行非法性行为的电影，并且还收藏着用过的女性内衣。

sentences.en: But Engler Höglund was nowhere to be seen.
sentences.zh: 但恩格拉·赫格隆德不见踪影。

sentences.en: Analysis of Ecklund's laptop revealed that he participated in online chat rooms that were accessible to users as young as 15.
sentences.zh: 对埃克隆德笔记本电脑的分析显示，他参与了年仅 15 岁用户即可访问的在线聊天室。

sentences.en: According to Often Blooded, online, Ecklund claimed to be a 37-year-old, quote,
sentences.zh: 据《Often Blooded》报道，在线上，埃克隆德声称自己是一个 37 岁的人，原话是

sentences.en: "...dark blonde, powerfully built truck driver." In reality, he was a bespectacled and overweight man with grey balding hair.
sentences.zh: “……黑金色头发、体格健壮的卡车司机。”现实中，他是一个戴着眼镜、大腹便便、顶着谢顶灰发的男人。

sentences.en: Fifty-six illicit images of children were also found saved to his hard drive.
sentences.zh: 在他的硬盘里还发现了 56 张保存在上面的儿童非法图片。

sentences.en: Karina Höglund woke on the third day of her daughter's disappearance to snow-covered ground.
sentences.zh: 卡里娜·赫格隆德在女儿失踪的第三天醒来时，地面已经覆盖了一层白雪。

sentences.en: An arrest had been made, but the cold snap in the weather meant that if Engler was out in the elements, her chances of survival were low.
sentences.zh: 警方已经实施了逮捕，但天气突然变冷意味着如果恩格拉暴露在恶劣天气中，她生还的几率很低。

sentences.en: Search efforts were consequently scaled down as police honed in on Anders Eklund.
sentences.zh: 因此，随着警方将重点锁定在安德斯·埃克隆德身上，搜寻工作也随之缩减。

sentences.en: Eklund denied having anything to do with Engler Höglund's disappearance and claimed to be shocked by the arreSt. Police were able to obtain a sample of Eklund's DNA
sentences.zh: 埃克隆德否认自己与恩格拉·赫格隆德的失踪有任何关系，并声称对被捕感到震惊。警方得以获取埃克隆德的 DNA 样本

sentences.en: and, to their surprise, it led to an unexpected discovery.
sentences.zh: 令他们惊讶的是，它带来了一个意想不到的发现。

sentences.en: Eight years earlier in the summer of
sentences.zh: 八年前的夏天

sentences.en: 2000, florist Pernilla Helgren packed her bags and left her home in Stockholm to begin a long journey through the Swedish countryside.
sentences.zh: 2000年，花商佩妮拉·海尔格伦收拾好行李，离开她在斯德哥尔摩的家，开始了一段穿过瑞典乡村的漫长旅程。

sentences.en: The 31-year-old was headed to the inland town of Forlen to visit her mother for her 50th birthday.
sentences.zh: 这位 31 岁的女子正前往内陆小镇福伦，为她的母亲庆祝 50 岁生日。

sentences.en: A party was held on the night of Saturday June 3, after which Pernilla and her sister left their mother's apartment and headed into town together.
sentences.zh: 6月3日星期六晚上举行了一场派对，之后佩妮拉和她的姐姐离开了母亲的公寓，一起前往镇上。

sentences.en: They visited two popular restaurants before getting swept up in the revelry of an annual street festival.
sentences.zh: 他们参观了两家受欢迎的餐厅，随后便融入了一年一度的街头艺术节的狂欢中。

sentences.en: It carried on into the early hours and by 2am on Sunday June 4, Pernilla had had enough.
sentences.zh: 狂欢一直持续到清晨，到 6 月 4 日星期日凌晨 2 点，佩妮拉已经受够了。

sentences.en: Wanting to go to bed, she parted ways with her sister and walked off alone in the direction of her mother's apartment, which was a few kilometres away.
sentences.zh: 由于想去睡觉，她和姐姐分道扬镳，独自朝着几公里外的母亲公寓方向走去。

sentences.en: Shortly after, teenager Linda Scherstrom was cycling home along a bike path about two kilometres south of Forlen's town centre.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，少年琳达·舍斯特伦正沿着福伦镇中心以南约两公里的自行车道骑车回家。

sentences.en: As she approached a small bridge, she heard grunting and groaning coming from a nearby cluster of trees.
sentences.zh: 当她接近一座小桥时，她听到附近的一丛树木中传出哼哼声和呻吟声。

sentences.en: Linda looked in the direction of the sound and saw a heavyset man sitting cross-legged on top of a slender woman.
sentences.zh: 琳达顺着声音的方向看去，看到一个身材魁梧的男人正盘腿坐在一个身材苗条的女人身上。

sentences.en: The woman's short blonde hair appeared to be stained with blood and it looked like the man had his hands wrapped around her throat.
sentences.zh: 那个女人的短金发似乎沾满了血迹，看起来那个男人的双手正搂着她的喉咙。

sentences.en: Linda rushed home and immediately phoned one of her friends, whose father was a police officer.
sentences.zh: 琳达冲回家，立刻给她的一个朋友打了电话，她朋友的父亲是一名警察。

sentences.en: Authorities rushed to the overpass and discovered the body of Pernilla Helgren.
sentences.zh: 当局冲到天桥上，发现了佩妮拉·海尔格伦的尸体。

sentences.en: She had been sexually assaulted and strangled to death.
sentences.zh: 她遭到性侵并被勒死。

sentences.en: The man responsible was nowhere to be seen.
sentences.zh: 肇事男子不见踪影。

sentences.en: While Pernilla's killer had worn a condom, his DNA was recovered on the leg of her trousers.
sentences.zh: 虽然佩妮拉的凶手戴了安全套，但她的裤腿上还是提取到了他的 DNA。

sentences.en: The sample was cross-checked against the DNA of 800 men, but there wasn't a match.
sentences.zh: 该样本与 800 名男性的 DNA 进行了交叉比对，但没有找到匹配项。

sentences.en: In time, Pernilla's case went cold.
sentences.zh: 随着时间推移，佩妮拉的案件成了一桩悬案。

sentences.en: That was until eight years later, when Undersh Eklund's DNA was filed following his arrest for the kidnapping of Engler Herglund.
sentences.zh: 直到八年后，安德斯·埃克隆德因涉嫌绑架恩格拉·赫格隆德被捕后，他的 DNA 才被存档。

sentences.en: While Eklund's DNA didn't reveal anything about Engler's case, it came back as a match to Pernilla
sentences.zh: 虽然埃克隆德的 DNA 没有透露任何关于恩格拉案的信息，但它与佩妮拉

sentences.en: Helgren's killer.
sentences.zh: 海尔格伦的凶手相匹配。

sentences.en: When detectives informed Eklund of this revelation, he requested a private conversation with his lawyer.
sentences.zh: 当侦探将这一发现告知埃克隆德时，他要求与他的律师私下谈谈。

sentences.en: Afterwards, he told the detectives that what had happened that summer had been gnawing away at him for eight years.
sentences.zh: 之后，他告诉侦探们，那个夏天发生的事情已经折磨了他八年之久。

sentences.en: Eklund had attended Forloon Street Festival on Sunday June 4.
sentences.zh: 埃克隆德于 6 月 4 日星期日参加了福伦街头艺术节。

sentences.en: He was heading back to his car in the early hours when he spotted Pernilla Helgren walking down the road.
sentences.zh: 清晨，他正准备回车里，突然看到佩妮拉·海尔格伦走在路上。

sentences.en: They struck up a conversation, during which Eklund claimed Pernilla invited him back to her mother's house for sex.
sentences.zh: 他们聊了起来，埃克隆德声称佩妮拉邀请他回她母亲家发生性关系。

sentences.en: Eklund suggested they slip into the nearby woods instead, but Pernilla was apprehensive.
sentences.zh: 埃克隆德建议他们溜进附近的树林里，但佩妮拉有些担忧。

sentences.en: Eklund dismissed her refusal and forced himself onto Pernilla as they crossed a bridge spanning a bike path.
sentences.zh: 埃克隆德对她的拒绝置之不理，当他们穿过横跨自行车道的一座桥时，他强暴了佩妮拉。

sentences.en: He struck her so hard in the head that she fell over the railing and rolled down the hill to the ground below.
sentences.zh: 他重重地击打她的头部，导致她从栏杆上摔下来，顺着山坡滚到了下方的地面上。

sentences.en: Blood seeped from her head wound.
sentences.zh: 鲜血从她的头部伤口渗出。

sentences.en: Eklund dragged Pernilla into the nearby trees and proceeded to rape her.
sentences.zh: 埃克隆德把佩妮拉拖进附近的树林里，并开始强奸她。

sentences.en: She tried to escape, but Eklund used his considerable weight to incapacitate her.
sentences.zh: 她试图逃跑，但埃克隆德利用他惊人的体重使她无法动弹。

sentences.en: Eklund claimed he never intended to kill Pernilla.
sentences.zh: 埃克隆德声称他从未打算杀死佩妮拉。

sentences.en: He just wanted to strangle her until she fell unconscious, so it would give him the chance to flee.
sentences.zh: 他只是想勒住她直到她失去知觉，这样他就有机会逃跑了。

sentences.en: Investigators were unconvinced of Eklund's version of events.
sentences.zh: 调查人员对埃克隆德的说法并不信服。

sentences.en: Whatever the truth, Eklund had confessed to raping and killing Pernilla Helgren.
sentences.zh: 不管真相如何，埃克隆德已经承认强奸并杀害了佩妮拉·海尔格伦。

sentences.en: While the DNA had convinced investigators of this fact, they were still stunned that he openly admitted to it.
sentences.zh: 虽然 DNA 让调查人员确信了这一事实，但他们依然震惊于他竟然公开承认了这一点。

sentences.en: Emboldened by Eklund's willingness to talk, interrogators once again brought up 10-year-old
sentences.zh: 受到埃克隆德愿意开口的鼓舞，审讯人员再次提到了 10 岁的

sentences.en: Angla Hergland.
sentences.zh: 恩格拉·赫格隆德。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: Casefile 稍后会回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持 Casefile 继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Eklund maintained he had nothing to do with Angla's disappearance, but ultimately requested to speak to his lawyer in private again.
sentences.zh: 埃克隆德坚称自己与恩格拉的失踪无关，但最终还是要求再次与他的律师私下交谈。

sentences.en: Afterwards, he began to tell another story.
sentences.zh: 随后，他开始讲述另一个故事。

sentences.en: On the afternoon of Saturday April 5, 2008,
sentences.zh: 2008年4月5日星期六下午

sentences.en: Eklund claimed he'd been driving home when he pulled over just outside of Scherensund to smoke a cigarette.
sentences.zh: 埃克隆德声称他当时正开车回家，在谢伦松德郊外把车停在路边抽烟。

sentences.en: Shortly after, Angla Herglund rode by on her bike.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，恩格拉·赫格隆德骑着自行车从旁边经过。

sentences.en: Eklund returned to his car and continued driving up the road.
sentences.zh: 埃克隆德回到车里，继续开车沿着公路前行。

sentences.en: He noticed the right-hand turn onto the gravel track that led into the nearby woods.
sentences.zh: 他注意到通往附近树林的碎石小路上有一个右转弯。

sentences.en: Eklund thought there might be some deforestation happening nearby and wondered if he could secure some work transporting wood chips in his truck.
sentences.zh: 埃克卢德认为附近可能正在进行森林砍伐，并想知道自己能否找到用卡车运输木屑的工作。

sentences.en: He turned onto the track and soon passed Angla again, who was cycling along the same route.
sentences.zh: 他拐上了这条小路，不久后又超过了正在同一条路上骑车的安格拉。

sentences.en: A little further ahead, Eklund parked his car and got out.
sentences.zh: 再往前一点，埃克卢德把车停下并下了车。

sentences.en: He wondered why Angla was cycling alone in such an isolated area.
sentences.zh: 他纳闷为什么安格拉会在这样一个偏僻的地方独自骑车。

sentences.en: When she approached,
sentences.zh: 当她靠近时，

sentences.en: Eklund asked if she lived nearby, to which Angla supposedly replied that she was taking a shortcut.
sentences.zh: 埃克卢德询问她是否住在附近，而安格拉据称回答说她是在走捷径。

sentences.en: Eklund claimed that Angla was acting arrogant and cheeky towards him and she kicked him in the leg.
sentences.zh: 埃克卢德声称安格拉对他的态度傲慢且无礼，并且她踢了他的腿。

sentences.en: This prompted Eklund to grab Angla and drag her towards his car.
sentences.zh: 这促使埃克卢德抓住安格拉，并将她拖向自己的汽车。

sentences.en: Although he denied it at first,
sentences.zh: 尽管他一开始予以否认，

sentences.en: Eklund eventually confessed to having sexually assaulted Angla.
sentences.zh: 但埃克卢德最终还是承认了自己对安格拉实施了性侵犯。

sentences.en: During the attack, Angla kicked
sentences.zh: 在袭击过程中，安格拉又踢了

sentences.en: Eklund again, causing him to stumble backwards.
sentences.zh: 埃克卢德一脚，导致他向后踉跄。

sentences.en: She tried to run away, but Eklund caught up with her quickly and threw her to the ground.
sentences.zh: 她试图逃跑，但埃克卢德很快追上了她并把她摔倒在地。

sentences.en: He was so enraged that he suffered what he described as some kind of tunnel vision.
sentences.zh: 他愤怒至极，以至于出现了他所说的某种隧道视野。

sentences.en: This led him to put his full weight on Angla's chest while proceeding to strangle her with his bare hands.
sentences.zh: 这导致他将全身的重量压在安格拉的胸口上，同时用双手勒住她的脖子。

sentences.en: He then put Angla's lifeless body in the trunk of his car before throwing her bike amongst the surrounding trees.
sentences.zh: 随后，他把安格拉毫无生气的尸体放进汽车后备箱，然后把她的自行车扔进了周围的树丛中。

sentences.en: Eklund began driving away from the scene, but before long he heard a noise coming from the trunk.
sentences.zh: 埃克卢德驾车离开现场，但没过多久，他听到后备箱里传出声音。

sentences.en: He stopped to investigate, realising it was the sound of Angla's mobile phone ringing in her jacket pocket.
sentences.zh: 他停下来查看，意识到那是安格拉夹克口袋里手机铃声响的声音。

sentences.en: It was her mother checking to see why she hadn't come home yet.
sentences.zh: 那是她的母亲打来电话，想看看她为什么还没回家。

sentences.en: Eklund threw the phone off to the side of the road, then continued home.
sentences.zh: 埃克卢德把手机扔到了路边，然后继续开车回家。

sentences.en: There, he changed his clothes and made himself a coffee.
sentences.zh: 在那里，他换了衣服，给自己煮了一杯咖啡。

sentences.en: He then got back into his car and continued driving, wanting to create as much distance between Angla and her home as possible.
sentences.zh: 接着他又坐回车里继续行驶，希望能尽量拉开安格拉与她家的距离。

sentences.en: Along the way, he stopped to buy cigarettes and eat a pizza until he reached a secluded foreSt. He removed Angla's body from the
sentences.zh: 一路上，他停下来买香烟、吃披萨，直到来到一处偏僻的森林。他将安格拉的尸体从

sentences.en: trunk of his car, doused her with petrol, and set her alight.
sentences.zh: 汽车后备箱里搬出来，泼上汽油并点燃了她。

sentences.en: On the drive home, Eklund visited a service station and washed his car.
sentences.zh: 在开车回家的路上，埃克卢德去了一个服务站洗车。

sentences.en: He found Angla's burgundy-rimmed glasses in the trunk and promptly threw them in a bin.
sentences.zh: 他在后备箱里发现了安格拉那副带有酒红色镜框的眼镜，并随手将它们扔进了垃圾桶。

sentences.en: His attempted clean-up wasn't perfect, as traces of Angla's blood were found on the tailgate of his car.
sentences.zh: 他试图清理的痕迹并不完美，因为在他的车尾板上发现了安格拉的血迹。

sentences.en: Officers searched the forest where Eklund claimed to have left Angla's body and soon found her charred remains.
sentences.zh: 警官们搜查了埃克卢德声称留下安格拉尸体的森林，不久便找到了她烧焦的遗骸。

sentences.en: Afterwards, a funeral service was held for Angla, with so many mourners packing out the church that many had to watch the event on large projector screens outside.
sentences.zh: 此后，各界为安格拉举行了葬礼，教堂里挤满了哀悼者，许多人不得不在外面的大型投影屏幕上观看仪式。

sentences.en: The service was also broadcast live around the nation.
sentences.zh: 葬礼还在全国范围内进行了现场直播。

sentences.en: This was a first for
sentences.zh: 这在

sentences.en: Sweden, a testament to the impact that Angla's ordeal had made.
sentences.zh: 瑞典尚属首次，这证明了安格拉遭遇的悲剧所产生的影响。

sentences.en: It allowed the whole country to remember Angla as the spirited young girl she was, and not just a murder victim.
sentences.zh: 它让全国人民都记住了安格拉生前那充满活力的少女形象，而不仅仅是一个谋杀受害者。

sentences.en: Undersh Eklund faced trial for the rape and murders of Pernilla Helgrion and Angla Herglund in July 2008.
sentences.zh: 2008年7月，安德斯·埃克卢德因强奸并谋杀佩妮拉·赫尔格里昂和安格拉·赫格隆德而面临审判。

sentences.en: With DNA and blood evidence linking him to both crime scenes, it was an open and shut case.
sentences.zh: 由于DNA和血液证据将他与两个犯罪现场联系在一起，这是一起铁证如山的案件。

sentences.en: Eklund took the stand, and while he didn't deny the crimes, he blamed a side of himself that he called Evil Lundesh.
sentences.zh: 埃克卢德出庭作证，虽然他没有否认罪行，但他将责任归咎于自己体内的一个被称为“邪恶隆德什”的人格面。

sentences.en: He admitted there was no logic in what he had done to Pernilla Helgrion, while still maintaining he had never intended to kill her.
sentences.zh: 他承认他对佩妮拉·赫尔格里昂所做的事情毫无逻辑可言，但同时坚称自己从未想过要杀死她。

sentences.en: Eklund's lawyer attempted to mitigate his client's moral responsibility by likening Angla Herglund's fate to a tragic accident.
sentences.zh: 埃克卢德的律师试图将安格拉·赫格隆德的命运比作一场悲惨的事故，以此来减轻他当事人的道德责任。

sentences.en: He quoted the famous short story To Kill a Child by Stig Dugerman, a Swedish journalist who rose to prominence in the aftermath of World War II.
sentences.zh: 他引用了二战后崭露头角的瑞典记者斯蒂格·达格曼的著名短篇小说《杀死一个小孩》。

sentences.en: In the piece, the protagonist accidentally kills a child by running over them with his car.
sentences.zh: 在这部作品中，主人公开车轧死了一个小孩，从而意外杀害了他。

sentences.en: Observers regarded this as an appalling attempt to elicit sympathy for Eklund.
sentences.zh: 旁观者认为这是企图为埃克卢德博取同情的令人发指的做法。

sentences.en: It was particularly upsetting for
sentences.zh: 这让

sentences.en: Karina Herglund, who swore under her breath as the prose was rather loud.
sentences.zh: 卡琳娜·赫格隆德感到格外痛苦，由于宣读的声音相当大，她气得压低声音咒骂。

sentences.en: Her profanities got louder and louder until she eventually shouted at Eklund and his lawyer, resulting in her removal from the courtroom.
sentences.zh: 她的粗话越来越大声，直到最后她冲着埃克卢德和他的律师大喊大叫，导致她被逐出法庭。

sentences.en: Before leaving, Karina looked directly at Eklund and snarled, Is that the best you can do?
sentences.zh: 离开前，卡琳娜直盯着埃克卢德厉声道：“这就是你能做到的最好表现吗？”

sentences.en: He stared back passively in response.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，他面无表情地回瞪着她。

sentences.en: Anders Eklund was found guilty on all counts and sentenced to life in prison.
sentences.zh: 安德斯·埃克卢德被判所有罪名成立，并被判处无期徒刑。

sentences.en: The district court rejected the stories he concocted about the lead-up to both attacks.
sentences.zh: 地区法院驳回了他关于这两起袭击事件发生前夕经过的虚构说法。

sentences.en: In Pernilla's case, it was likely he had stalked her as she walked home alone from the street festival.
sentences.zh: 就佩妮拉的案件而言，他很可能是在她从街头节庆活动独自步行回家的路上尾随了她。

sentences.en: She had not propositioned him like he had claimed.
sentences.zh: 她并没有像他所声称的那样主动勾引他。

sentences.en: The court was also dismissive of Eklund's story about driving down the path that led him to Engler in search of work.
sentences.zh: 法院同样对埃克卢德关于为寻找工作而开车驶入通往埃格勒的小路的说法不予采信。

sentences.en: They had no doubts that his sole motivation to turn down the forested track was to assault the ten-year-old.
sentences.zh: 他们毫不怀疑他拐进那条林间小路的唯一动机就是袭击这个十岁的小女孩。

sentences.en: Pernilla's father spoke of how Eklund's guilty verdict brought to an end eight years of uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 佩妮拉的父亲谈到，埃克卢德的有罪判决如何结束了长达八年的不确定状态。

sentences.en: He described those times as a rollercoaster between hope and despair.
sentences.zh: 他将那段时光形容为希望与绝望之间的一场过山车。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引述：

sentences.en: Every time I woke up, I knew there was someone on the loose that had murdered my daughter.
sentences.zh: “每次我醒来，我都清楚地知道外面有一个杀害了我女儿的凶手在逍遥法外。”

sentences.en: Neither I nor my family have lived properly.
sentences.zh: “我和我的家人都没有真正好好生活过。”

sentences.en: Now it feels better, but far from good.
sentences.zh: “现在感觉好一点了，但远算不上好。”

sentences.en: You live with this every single day.
sentences.zh: “你每天都要面对这样的生活。”

sentences.en: Andesh Eklund was housed in a sex offenders ward, where in 2014 he was attacked by his fellow inmates.
sentences.zh: 安德斯·埃克卢德被关押在性犯罪者监区，2014年他在那里遭到同监犯人的袭击。

sentences.en: As a result, the process began to have him moved to a new facility for his own safety.
sentences.zh: 因此，为了他自身的安全，有关部门开始着手将他转移到新的设施。

sentences.en: In 2018, after ten years in prison, Eklund applied to have his life sentence commuted to a fixed term.
sentences.zh: 2018年，在服刑十年后，埃克卢德申请将他的无期徒刑减为有期徒刑。

sentences.en: This opened up the possibility of parole.
sentences.zh: 这带来了假释的可能性。

sentences.en: His request was denied, as the court found him to be a, quote,
sentences.zh: 他的请求被拒绝了，因为法院认定他具有，引述：

sentences.en: concrete and significant risk of relapsing into a serious crime.
sentences.zh: “重新陷入严重犯罪的现实且重大风险。”

sentences.en: Eklund's request to move prisons was granted in 2020.
sentences.zh: 埃克卢德要求调往其他监狱的请求于2020年获得批准。

sentences.en: Upon his arrival, Eklund was beaten by a fellow prisoner.
sentences.zh: 他一到达新监狱，就遭到了一名同狱犯人的殴打。

sentences.en: Swedish authorities continue to investigate Andesh Eklund as a possible suspect in other violent, unsolved sex crimes across Sweden.
sentences.zh: 瑞典当局继续将安德斯·埃克卢德作为瑞典各地其他未破的暴力性犯罪案件的潜在嫌疑人进行调查。

sentences.en: In any case, he will die in prison.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，他将在狱中度过余生。

sentences.en: In the aftermath of Andesh Eklund's trial for the murders of Penilla Helgren and Engla Herglund, information came to light that stunned the community.
sentences.zh: 在安德斯·埃克卢德因谋杀佩妮拉·赫尔格伦和埃格拉·赫格隆德而受审之后，一些让社区震惊的信息浮出水面。

sentences.en: When police were first attempting to identify Penilla's killer in the year 2000, they drew up a list of Sweden's known violent sex offenders.
sentences.zh: 2000年，当警方最初试图确定佩妮拉的凶手时，他们开出了一份瑞典已知的暴力性犯罪者名单。

sentences.en: It featured 1213 names.

sentences.en: Andesh Eklund was number 21.
sentences.zh: 安德斯·埃克卢德排在第21位。

sentences.zh: 尽管嫌疑人名单逐渐缩减，但埃克卢德的名字依然在列。

sentences.en: Despite having solidified his spot on the suspect list, Andesh Eklund wasn't one of the 800 men whose DNA was cross-checked against the DNA recovered from Penilla's trousers.
sentences.zh: 尽管安德斯·埃克卢德在嫌疑人名单上的位置十分稳固，但他却不在那800名将其DNA与从佩妮拉裤子上提取的DNA进行交叉比对的男子之列。

sentences.en: In fact, the overwhelming majority of those men were just ordinary citizens with no history of sexual violence.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这其中绝大多数人只是没有性犯罪史的普通公民。

sentences.en: Police then seemingly disregarded their suspect list altogether and instead relied heavily on tips from the public, none of which led anywhere.
sentences.zh: 随后，警方似乎完全忽视了他们的嫌疑人名单，转而严重依赖公众提供的线索，然而这些线索全都无疾而终。

sentences.en: Their reason was that nothing about it, quote, stuck out.

sentences.en: Engler Herglund's family sued the Swedish government for the failures of police.
sentences.zh: 埃格拉·赫格隆德的家人起诉瑞典政府，指控警方办案不力。

sentences.en: Despite their grief, Karina and Sewell advocate for other victims of crimes.
sentences.zh: 尽管悲痛欲绝，卡琳娜和塞韦尔仍在大力倡导为其他犯罪受害者发声。

sentences.en: Karina has always sought to speak personally with Andesh Eklund.
sentences.zh: 卡琳娜一直试图亲自与安德斯·埃克卢德对话。

sentences.zh: 在接受《快报》采访时，卡琳娜思索着如果埃格拉还活着，她的人生会是什么样。

sentences.en: Since she was a little girl, Engler loved being in the spotlight.
sentences.zh: 从小到大，埃格拉一直热爱成为聚光灯下的焦点。

sentences.en: She entered as many talent contests as she could, singing and dancing to the delight of her audience.
sentences.zh: 她参加了所有能参加的才艺比赛，用歌声和舞蹈给观众带来欢乐。

sentences.en: A recording of Engler performing had been played during her funeral service, sharing her joy to the nation.
sentences.zh: 一段埃格拉表演的录像曾在她的葬礼上播放，向全国分享她的快乐。

sentences.en: Karina imagined Engler would have grown up to live in Stockholm and attended Kultharama, the largest performing arts college in the Nordic region.
